supportBasis: User approved both native Windows pairings for this bounded disposable fixture on 2026-10-30; no general support policy asserted.
firstCellPerPairing: S0-en with current mode, localized Search focus and NVDA cancellation-response controls
continuation: Finish all 48 windows only if first native cell and controls establish a stable capture environment. Repeated identical setup/external foreground failures across pairings stop that environment; no substitution by AX/DOM.
boundedRetry: At most one additional selected-cell attempt per pairing for a demonstrated correctable capture/setup defect; fresh output per attempt. Do not repeat an unchanged external foreground failure indefinitely.
speechLimit: Speech Viewer queued text arrival at 100 ms sampling; does not establish audible completion or word-level onset.
